Although it is not specifically mentioned in the text, scholars agree that the sea mentioned is the Dead Sea. Because the Dead Sea has no outlet and loses water through evaporation, salt builds up as much as 25 percent, making it so salty that fish can’t survive. (See Radmacher and others,NKJV Study Bible[2018], 1238, note onEzekiel 47:7–12. See also Ellis T. Rasmussen,A Latter-day Saint Commentary on the Old Testament[1993], 614.)

SeeEzekiel 1:10. The Apostle John saw a similar vision, as recorded in the book of Revelation. The Prophet Joseph Smith explained that the four beasts in John’s vision represented classes of beings (seeDoctrine and Covenants 77:3). It is unclear whether the animals in Ezekiel’s vision represent the same thing.
